system.specialAbility:
You become Trained in Guile and Performance, and you become Trained in a relevant Lore of your choice.

Example Lores include Confidence Schemes Lore, Stagecraft Lore, False Credentials Lore.
system.description: You lived by selling convincing stories, borrowed credentials, or cures that promised rather more than they delivered. You learned to become the person an audience wanted to believe.
